collection.title: SEAT Toledo 1999 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Toledo 1999 to 2004 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
